621.note: MSG is not regulated as a food additive in Canada (treated as a flavour enhancer, no regulatory limit), but must be declared on the ingredient label.
621.source: canada.ca — Monosodium Glutamate (MSG) Questions and Answers

211.note: Sodium benzoate is a permitted preservative under Health Canada's List of Permitted Preservatives, subject to specified maximum levels per food category.
211.source: canada.ca — Notice of Modification to the List of Permitted Preservatives

171.note: Titanium dioxide (E171) remains permitted in Canada under Good Manufacturing Practice, per Health Canada's June 2022 State of the Science review.
171.source: canada.ca — Titanium dioxide (TiO2) as a food additive: Current science report
